The native HiveServer2 adapter follows Apache Hive's TCLIService protocol.
Protocol reference: https://github.com/apache/hive/blob/master/service-rpc/if/TCLIService.thrift
License: Apache License, Version 2.0 (vendor/hive-protocol/LICENSE).
The reference IDL and its source URL/digest are in vendor/hive-protocol/.
No Java or JDBC process is used by the native Hive connection.

Kerberos uses the cross-krb5 0.5.0 safe system interface (MIT license).
Source: https://github.com/estokes/cross-krb5
It uses Windows SSPI, or the Unix system GSSAPI (libgssapi/libgssapi-sys,
MIT license). The system ticket cache is used without changing saved passwords.
SASL security-layer reference: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4752

Optional protocol QA downloads the unmodified Apache Hive service-rpc 4.1.0,
Apache Thrift 0.16.0 and SLF4J API 1.7.36 artifacts from Maven Central.
These are test fixtures, are SHA-256 pinned in scripts/qa/hive.py, and are not
redistributed in the application. Their own licenses remain embedded in the jars.
